question: Should OpenClaw ship the full Wear OS companion in one release after the validation and proof blockers are resolved, or return to the staged delivery described by the canonical issue?
rationale: The canonical issue proposes three reviewable stages, while this PR consolidates the full chat, voice, notification, tile, security, and release surface into one protected maintainer change; that scope choice requires explicit product and release ownership.

options.title: Approve the consolidated companion
options.body: Keep the current phone-proxy-only scope and land it after both findings, exact-head physical proof, and release/security approval are complete.

options.title: Return to staged delivery
options.body: Split protocol and phone bridge, watch interaction, and release packaging into separately proven landing steps.

options.title: Pause first-party Wear
options.body: Close or defer the bundled companion if the ongoing release and security ownership cost is not currently acceptable.

recommendation.title: Approve the consolidated companion
recommendation.body: Keep the current phone-proxy-only scope and land it after both findings, exact-head physical proof, and release/security approval are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the canonical product proposal and consolidated implementation, making them the strongest available owner for the intended delivery shape.
